description:
The World of Warcraft: Forever team discuss the driving philosophy behind the game's new additions, and dive deeper into the history of the Skyborne and WoW: Forever's new zones.

Take new first steps through lands untrodden when World of Warcraft: Forever launches November 4, 2026. Or, uncover Azeroth’s mysteries early by playing in the WoW: Forever Beta starting September 17, 2026, when you pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or the Warcraft Forever Collection.
